items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 62:1
items.html: The male of Arich Anpin is the level of Hochma that came out in Atzilut, upon a screen of phase three, in the inclusion of the coupling in the Rosh of Atik. And the Nukva of Arich Anpin is the phase of the lower half of the Keter of Nekudim, which is the phase of AHP of Keter that came out at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim, by a new light that broke through the Parsa and illuminated the Keter of Nekudim through the Tabur of AK. And it is called the BON of Arich Anpin. (Inner Light, page 626, Sub Header, “And Arich”)
